title: The tin, rusting
logline: The pushpin tin on Gully's counter, close, rusting at the hinge, twenty-six years of pins. The girl's hand reaching for it at the edge, fourteen now.

panels.composition: Close on a small pushpin tin on a wooden counter rusting at its hinge, a teenage girl's hand reaching for it at the frame's edge.
